div.span:
• In force: the newest record currently effective for each scope and channel.
• Deny wins across the blanket and channel levels.
• No record means permit, as synthetic data on the resident's own record.
• A decision is never edited. Withdrawing is recording the opposite status.
• A resident is unreachable only when every channel is denied.
